title: Kota Kinabalu, Sabah — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Kota Kinabalu, Sabah: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Kota Kinabalu is a city in Sabah with a population of 500,000. Sabah’s capital and the gateway to Borneo’s natural wonders, with stunning sunsets and Mount Kinabalu views. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
